topics.title: Nvidia board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director
topics.summary: On November 23, 2026, Nvidia announced its board voted unanimously to reinstate Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director effective immediately, reversing its November 18 stance. The board said input from senior U.S. government officials gave it confidence his return poses no national security risk. Interim CEO Colette Kress continues as CFO while Harvey Jones remains chair.

topics.title: Enterprise AI agent startup Sierra raises $1.75 billion at a $30 billion valuation
topics.summary: On November 23, 2026, enterprise AI agent startup Sierra announced a $1.75 billion Series F round at a $30 billion valuation, doubling its valuation within six months of its previous $15 billion round. Greenoaks and Lightspeed Venture Partners led the financing, with existing lead backers Benchmark, Sequoia Capital, GV and Tiger Global also participating.

topics.title: OpenAI and Cisco launch Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime to block AI-driven exploits
topics.summary: On November 23, 2026, OpenAI and Cisco launched Shirudo, an open-source runtime designed to protect running Linux systems against AI-driven cyberattacks while teams roll out permanent patches. In a controlled test, a Codex-generated shield blocked a Java4Shell exploit attempt against a running Elasticsearch service without requiring a restart or taking legitimate requests offline.
